title: Your CPF retirement sums in 60 seconds
text: Three numbers every Singaporean turning 55 in 2026 should know.

title: Basic Retirement Sum: S$110,200
text: The basic sum for members turning 55 in 2026.

title: Full Retirement Sum: S$220,400
text: Twice the basic sum. It sets a higher monthly payout for life.

title: Enhanced Retirement Sum: S$440,800
text: The most you can set aside in 2026 for the highest payouts.

title: CPF LIFE pays out from 65
text: Your retirement sum becomes a monthly payout for as long as you live.
